template_departures: Travelling sun patch: the source holds a static background gradient for the whole clip. Here one warm sun ellipse travels top-left to bottom-right across all 15s, cooling as it goes. This reproduces the site's own signature move (WINDOW LIGHT) and is the single change that makes the film read as sigouin.net.
Ground drift: the cream canvas cools to #E7E9EE during phase 5, echoing the site's scroll-driven ground shift at the homelab chapter. The source background never changes value.

One accent instead of four: the source flashes wine crimson, amber, raspberry and olive lime on word landings. The site's design law is one accent, so every landing flash is blue #2454CC and the only other colour is the sun's amber. Confetti accents would break the site's own rule.

Bridge icon is a four-pane window, not the source's clock ring with spinning hands. Time is not this film's message, light is. The window supports the same large-to-inline transformation and ties the bridge to the site's signature move.
Palette rebound entirely to the site's live tokens (canvas #F4F2ED, ink #16181B, accent #2454CC, sun #FFE4B2/#FFC884/#F1C98F) instead of the source's bone-white/lilac/lime.
Audio: the source prompt is explicitly silent. Per the skill's default for a new motion campaign this became instrumental music plus synchronized effects, no narration.
Timing: the 10-second source phases (0-2, 2-4, 4-5.5, 5.5-7.5, 7.5-10) were retimed by the template's 1.5x multiplier to 15s (0-3, 3-6, 6-8.25, 8.25-11.25, 11.25-15). Timing is authored, not source.
